Engaging Wahab & Co to review RHSTEP and BAPSA

description.narrative:
A. Wahab & Co. will assess the institutional capacity of RHSTEP and BAPSA in the following areas
• Financial management – o Financial accounting procedures; o Cash and bank management; o Fixed Assets Management o Budgetary control o Financial reporting • Procurement management • Audit arrangements • Management of risk and anti-corruption • Sustainability

PLEASE REVIEW YOUR ANSWER AS THE QUESTION HAS BEEN CHANGED
EMB of Sweden Dhaka intends to conduct an assesment of institutional and financial management capacity of RHSTEP and BAPSA which includes itnernal control and management according to attached ToR appendix 1 before signing the agreement with RHSTEP and BAPSA for the period of 2014-2017 , taken from SRHR follow up fund ( Agreement No A0000448 ). EMB/Dhaka with the support of Wahab and Co. carries thorugh the review via frame work agreement between the Embassy and Wahab and Co.
